text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I felt a fearsome wind. Graded races
really are of
a different caliber.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I believe this to be the nurturing breeze
of spring.
This race has yielded a great
bounty...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved fantastic results,
Yamanin
Zephyr establishes herself as
one of the next
generation's top milers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And, as if she were in direct competition
with
Yamanin Zephyr herself...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Tokai Teio in front! Tokai Teio leads

triumphantly! Second place is closing in,
but she
won't let anyone past! What a
powerhouse!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio takes the win! Tokai Teio
crosses the
finish line with pure finesse!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She took the lead at the fourth corner
and never
let up!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
An undefeated Satsuki Sho champion is
born!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...You were a gallant gale, Tokai Teio.
That was
fantastic.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Trainer. The next wind to blow
will be all
ours.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
We can't afford to stand still. Even if the
enduring
winds of autumn mean to blow
us down, we'll
simply soar to greater
currents!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by Tokai Teio, Yamanin
Zephyr is
brimming with enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that means there's momentum to
ride...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The Aoi Stakes? A 1200-meter sprint...
So I'm to
become a wind that rushes
faster still?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod. Now's the time to really polish the
finest
weapon she wields—her speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's not all!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh! At long last!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind picks up, and the gentle
breeze shall
become a gale. And then...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I can hardly wait.
